about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the foundation module kernel becomes the workspace package @purin-labs/kernel in foundation/kernel. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package: the manifest and the tsconfig of the new package; the versions of devDependencies come from versionsFrom. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs, and of a path that is no import; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again.

edits.why: the lints that walk the product source read the new root folder
the lints of the Worker source and ESLint read the new root folder
the clone scan reads the new root folder
knip reads each package of the new root folder and judges each export of it (includeEntryExports, since c8e50933)
ESLint reads the new root folder in pnpm lint:ifc-boundaries
pnpm check:packages runs the type check of each package of the new root folder
the template of the generated action registry imports the Result type of the kernel

keepForm.why: pnpm lint:clones. This file and credential-revocation-resolution.ts have the same eight imports: 69 tokens, one below the limit of jscpd (70). With the package name, the import of two id types is 83 characters. Prettier wraps it and adds a final comma, which is token 70, so jscpd reports a new copy of 11 lines. One statement for each name gives 75 tokens. The functions below the imports are not copies.
pnpm lint:clones. The second file of the pair above.

pnpm lint:layer-debts. The file is a logic file of the Worker module, and the kind worker-logic counts its lines. With the package name, the import of parseOrganisationId and OrganisationId is 84 characters. Prettier wraps it into 4 lines, so the count lines workers/platform goes from 3778 to 3781 with no new logic.
